t: I'm really excited about this workshop on digital marketing tomorrow.
I wish I could say the same.
I heard the moderator is very knowledgeable.
He's well known in the field and he's super accomplished, but I heard him give a talk at the marketing expo last year and I was afraid it would never end.
If I were you, I'd think twice before skipping.
The managers make a note of who shows up for these things.
